title: A remote attacker must authenticate with Read Only (GroupRead) access to at least one Worker Group… (CVE-2026-115873)
description: CVE-2026-115873 is a critical vulnerability that requires an attacker to have authenticated Read Only (GroupRead) access to at least one Worker Group and access to the Leader API. The attacker can exploit a flaw in the nested compiler by crafting a malicious expression, allowing code execution with the Leader service account's permissions, resulting in full confidentiality, integrity, and availability compromise.
